caption: The drawing depicts a wooden four-poster bed positioned at an angle so that two of its sides are visible. The bed has tall, square, unadorned corner posts with rounded finials at the very bottom, and is constructed from light brown wood, including the headboard, footboard, and side rails. The headboard is slightly shaped with a gentle curve and minimal decorative carving. The mattress on the bed is covered with a woven blanket or coverlet featuring a geometric pattern consisting of alternating squares and rectangles in shades of blue and white. The bed is placed on a blank, cream-colored background with no additional objects or decoration. Near the bottom right corner of the image, there is a small artist's signature and some handwritten numbers or text.
title: Four Poster Bed
